# md4c

Vendored copy of [md4c](https://github.com/mity/md4c) release 0.5.2 (MIT license, see `vendor/LICENSE.md`).

It builds the `md2html` host tool used by `bin/gen_html` to convert the Markdown sources of the About window and Help book to HTML, so no external Markdown compiler is needed to build OakMate.

To update, replace the files in `vendor/` with those from `src/` of a newer md4c release.
